name: pi-profile
description: One Pi activity profile published to Lakebed and ChatGPT Sites

scripts.build: npm run build:lakebed && npm run build:sites
scripts.build:lakebed: node src/prepare-lakebed.js && lakebed build capsule --target anonymous
scripts.check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.deploy: node src/prepare-lakebed.js && cd capsule && lakebed deploy
scripts.publish:lakebed: npm run aggregate && npm run build:lakebed && npm run deploy
